summary: Wrote a three-phase implementation plan for the restack subcommand of review-stack-prepare.sh, decomposed along the plan/print/execute seam the file's own cut implementation already uses so each phase closes green independently. All four measurable claims in the dispatch description were verified unchanged against live state (38 passing cases, exit codes contiguous through 52, no restack dispatch arm, both static assertions green). The research report's three PD7 ambiguity readings were adopted verbatim as plan decisions D1-D3, with D4 adding a compute-all-before-moving-anything ordering that makes 'a conflict moves nothing' structural. One figure inherited from the parent plan was stale and is corrected in the plan: the touched-path selector now resolves this phase's two paths to a real suite rather than the __FULL_SWEEP__ sentinel.
